summary: Closing a tamper alarm now needs the admin's own sign-in.

fixes.title: Tamper alarms close only after checking your sign-in
fixes.text: When you accept a change on the Tamper page, the engine checks your own sign-in before it closes the alarm. The alarm closes at the next monitor run, within minutes.

fixes.title: The web app cannot change the licence
fixes.text: The web app can only reset a refused licence claim. The licence itself is written only by the update job.
